name: B&M Sheet Metal
description: ​B & M Sheet Metal offers many services including laser cutting, bending, shearing, plasma cutting, ductwork, kitchen hoods and refurbishing stainless steel elevators. We stock stainless steel, steel, aluminum, galvanized, galvanneal, copper and brass in sheets. We also stock, flatbar, angle, tubing - round and square, and solid rod. B & M specializes in taking customers measurements and fabricating the job accordingly. We also measure, fabricate and install most projects and can quote most jobs before fabrication.
